gold_points: Pandemic may shift earnings mix by customer type and jurisdiction
Prolonged operating losses could lead to valuation allowances on deferred tax assets
Sustained adverse impacts may increase likelihood of impairment charges or write-offs of goodwill, intangibles, inventories, receivables
Longer-term impacts include enhanced health and hygiene costs and slow reopening of venues

output.question: In Sysco's fiscal 2021 10-K, how does the company say the COVID-19 pandemic could affect its income taxes and the valuation of its assets even after the pandemic subsides?
